model.description: Impressed brings you Zangria, a premium 1g pre-roll that's ready to light up your experience. This expertly crafted preroll showcases the brand's commitment to quality and convenience, delivering smooth, consistent draws from start to finish. Zangria offers a vibrant flavor profile with fruity, citrus notes balanced by subtle herbal undertones that dance across the palate. Each pre-roll is carefully packed with finely ground flower to ensure an even burn and optimal enjoyment. Perfect for on-the-go sessions or sharing with friends, this single gram pre-roll provides just the right amount for a satisfying smoke. Whether you're unwinding after a long day or enhancing social moments, Impressed Zangria delivers a memorable cannabis experience in a convenient, portable format. No grinding, no rolling—just pure enjoyment.
